name: Weather
description: Leaves the sound out in the weather: gusts of wind, clouds passing over, rain tapping on it, surf washing through it or a storm, each moving its level and tone and adding a thin sound of its own.

params.name: Kind
params.description: Which weather the sound is left out in: gusting wind, passing clouds, rain, surf breaking over it, or a storm of wind, rain and far thunder together.

params.name: Force
params.description: How strong the weather is: the height of the gusts, the depth of the shadows, how hard it rains, the size of the waves. At zero the sound is left alone.

params.name: Pace
params.description: How fast the weather changes. Low settings give long slow gusts, clouds and waves. High settings make them short and quick, and the rain falls faster.

params.name: Exposure
params.description: How much the weather moves the sound itself: its level sinks and its highs dull under each gust, shadow, drop or wave. At zero the sound is untouched.

params.name: Voice
params.description: How much of the weather's own sound is heard: the whistle of the wind, the drops, the wash of the surf, the thunder. At zero the weather makes no sound.

params.name: Colour
params.description: Dark to bright weather. Low settings howl, thud and roar and dull more of the sound. High settings whistle, tick and fizz and take only its top.

params.name: Sway
params.description: How much the weather moves from side to side: gusts lean, drops scatter, clouds and waves cross from one side to the other. At zero it all stays in the middle.

params.name: Calm
params.description: How long the lulls between gusts, clouds, showers and waves are. At zero one follows the other. Turned up, the sound is left in peace for longer.

params.name: Linger
params.description: How long the weather carries on after the sound stops, before it fades away and the device goes silent.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the sound out in the weather.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Five small weather models (gusts, cloud shadows, rain drops, surf, thunder) drawn from seeded random streams: none of them an LFO and none a recording.
